Lead times average 2.43 working days with moderate variability (CV=0.45) driven predominantly by transport uncertainty. The SAP baseline carries zero safety stock, leaving the operation exposed to demand and supply variability; a (r,Q) continuous-review policy with SS=12,271 and Q=139,049 achieves the 95% service level target while staying well within storage capacity.
